segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Hello, and welcome to Focus on the Arts.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'm your host - Dave Green - and this is your very own local radio programme.Every Friday evening we put the spotlighton different arts and culture facilities, and look at the shows and events that are on offer in the coming week.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And today the focus is on The NationalArts Centre.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now, if you don't already know it yourself, I'm sure you've all heard of it.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's famous throughoutthe world as one of the major 011 venues for classical music.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But did you know that it is actually much more than just a place to hear concerts?The Centre itself is a huge complexthat caters for a great range of arts.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Under a single roof it houses concert rooms,theatres,cinemas,art galleries and a wonderfulpublic library, as well as service facilitiesincludingthree restaurantsand a bookshop.So at any one time, 012 the choice of entertainmentthere is simply enormous.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So, how did they manageto build such a big Arts complex right in the heart of the city?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, the area was completelydestroyedby bombs during the war in 1940.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So the opportunitywas taken to create a cultural centre that would be, what they called: 'the City's gift to the Nation'.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Of course it took a while for such a big project to get started, but it was planned in the 60s, built in the 70s and eventuallyopened to the public in 1983.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Ever since 013 & 14 then it has provedto be a great success.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It is not privatelyowned, like many arts centres, but is still in public hands- it's run by the City Council.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Both our NationalSymphony 015 Orchestraand NationalTheatre Companywere involvedin the planningof the project, and they are now based there - giving regular performancesevery week - and as the Centre is open 3?3 days of the year, there are plenty of performancesto choose fr_om. 016 So, to give you some idea of what's on, and to help you choosefrom the many possibilities, we've made a selectionof the star attractions.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you're interestedin classical music, then we recommendyou go along to the Nationalon either Mondayor Tuesdayeveningat 7.30 for a spectacularproductionof 'The Magic Flute' - probablythe most popularof all Mozart'soperas.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's in the Garden Hall and tickets start 017 at only £8.00, but you'll have to be early if you want to get them that cheap!

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And remember, it's only on for those two evenings.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For those more interestedin the cinema,you might like to see the new Canadianfilm which is showingon Wednesdayeveningat 8pm in Cinema 2.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And that's called 'Three Lives.' It's 018 had fantastic reviewsand tickets cost just £4.50, which is a reductionon the usual price of O 19 £5.50.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So, it's really good value, especiallyfor such a great movie.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But you can see the centre's main attractionat the weekend,becauseon Saturdayand Sunday, 11 am to 10 pm, they're showinga wonderfulnew exhibitionthat hasn't been seen anywhereelse in Europeyet.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's a collectionof ChineseArt called 'Faces of China' that's 020 in Gallery 1 - and it has some really fascinating paintings and sculptures by leading artists from all over China - and the good news is that it is completely free, so don't miss it!

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So why not go along to the National Arts Centre next week for one - or all - of these great events - and you can always pick up a programmeand check out all the other performancesand exhibitions on offer, or coming soon, on almost every day of the year.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Next week we'll.be looking at the new Museum of Science ...
